transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Well, I came in because my eating has just gotten all turned around. It's been like this for months now. Some days I just pick at a piece of toast and a cup of coffee, and that's it. But then other days... I'll end up standing in the bakery aisle at the store, buying all these sweets that I don't even really enjoy eating. It's just very strange for me.
When those episodes happen, do you eat what most people would consider a very large amount of food?

No, I wouldn't really say it's a huge amount of food. It's not like I'm eating a whole cake or anything like that. I might just eat... I don't know, a couple of donuts or half a package of cookies at once. It's just a lot of junk that I wouldn't normally ever touch, but it's probably not what you'd call a massive amount.
Are you very afraid of gaining weight?

No, not really. I mean, I'm not worried about my weight or the scale or anything like that. It's just... the eating itself is what bothers me, because it's so out of character. But no, I wouldn't say I'm afraid of gaining weight at all.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Yes, I have been. Most days I wake up with this heavy, sad feeling just sitting on me. Even when I'm in my bright kitchen with the coffee going, it's like... I feel like the warmth has just gone out of everything. It's been really hard to shake.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yes, I have. I used to get really excited about things like putting together quilting squares, going to bowling night, or even just planning the church potlucks. But lately... I don't know, I look at my sewing supplies or I see the church calendar, and I just can't make myself care the way I used to. The interest just isn't there anymore.
Have you been having trouble sleeping?
No, not really. I've been sleeping alright, actually. I usually go to bed and sleep through the night without much trouble. So, no, sleep hasn't been an issue for me.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy lately?

Yes, I have. Even after a full night of sleep, on those nights when my aunt doesn't call out for me, I still feel completely worn down by breakfast. It's like... just doing simple things, like carrying a basket of laundry or making a few phone calls, it just takes so much more out of me than it should. I just don't have the energy I used to.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?
No, I haven't really noticed any problems with that. I mean... if I need to sit down and read something or pay the bills, I can still focus on it just fine. So, no, my concentration seems okay.
Have you been feeling worried or anxious a lot lately?
No, I wouldn't say so. I mean... I don't feel nervous or on edge or anything like that. I'm not really sitting around worrying about things. So, no, anxiety hasn't been an issue for me.
Have these low mood symptoms been present most days for at least two weeks?
Yes, it's been most days. Actually, it's been going on for about seven months now. It started right around the time my aunt came to live with me, after she had her fall.
Have you had less appetite than usual lately?

Well, actually, that's a big part of why I'm here. My eating has just been all turned around for months now. Some days I have no appetite at all... I'll just pick at a piece of toast and have some coffee. But then other days, I'll find myself standing in the bakery aisle buying all these sweets that I don't even really enjoy eating. It's just very unpredictable.
Have you been feeling worthless or excessively guilty lately?

No, I wouldn't say that. I don't feel worthless... and I don't really have anything to feel guilty about, either. I'm just doing the best I can with everything right now. So, no, I haven't been feeling like that.
Have you been having thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of wanting to die?
No, I haven't had any thoughts like that. I mean, it's been a tough few months, but... no, I definitely don't want to die. I haven't felt like life isn't worth living.
